_comment: CreateTable spec for the immutable ledger.
This lives in its own table for three reasons:
1. Immutability becomes an IAM guarantee, not a code convention -- the
gateway role gets PutItem here but not UpdateItem or DeleteItem, which
cannot be expressed if budget counters share the table.
2. Every stream record is exactly one financial event with a stable id, so
the runaway detector reads a clean feed instead of filtering millions of
3. TransactWriteItems spans tables in-region, so splitting costs no
